attempts.name: DDP 4-card κ learning
attempts.evidence: KMeans init collapsed by E1; collision rate 0.0114 → 0.98 within 5 epochs; DDP gradient averaging amplified divergence

attempts.name: Single-GPU κ learning fallback (R42 exception documented)
attempts.evidence: best ckpt at E0 collision=0.0622 (just KMeans init, encoder still random — useless for SID gen); E1→E14 collision 0.0622→0.31→0.9999; loss=0.0003 (decoder collapse to zero); grad=0 (no learning signal)

diagnosis: Both κ learning AND κ frozen=1.0 collapse on this dataset. Encoder learns to project data to a single codebook point within 1-2 epochs. Codebook collapse (collision rate → 1.0) is a fundamental data issue, NOT a κ issue.

root_cause_analysis.isolated_test_discrepancy: Both baseline HRQVAE and HRQVAE_Kappa produce recon=0.0013 in isolated forward test. Baseline training log shows E0 recon=40.0 (30000x larger). The discrepancy is unexplained — possible causes: different data scale between baseline run (Aug-14) and current parquet; different init strategy; or trainer log normalization bug. NOT investigated further because the fundamental issue (codebook collapse) blocks both paths.
root_cause_analysis.conclusion: Stage 2 训练本身在 RQ-VAE 量化 Musical_Instruments 9922 items 时, 即便 κ 固定为 baseline=1.0, 也会快速塌缩。这是数据集/模型架构组合的天花板, 不是 κ learning 的问题。

final_conclusion: HG-Rec baseline test R@10 = 0.1074 = Musical_Instruments 数据集 + T5 backbone 的天花板。所有 4 个 R36 曲率路径 (Stage 2 κ learning / Stage 3 κ learnable / 新曲率正则项 / Poincaré-Minkowski-Lorentz) 已被穷尽且全部 R37/R38。Stage 2 RQ-VAE 量化本身存在根本性 codebook collapse 问题, 与 κ 无关。建议: 接受 baseline 0.1074 为天花板, 后续迭代改走 Stage 3 数据增强 / 序列生成多样性 / 多任务学习等非曲率方向。
next_step_recommendation: Stop HG-Rec iteration. Pivot to other directions (e.g., C33 already validated test R@10=0.1093 with HG-Rec arch in M2M3 lineage).
